assessments.summary: Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 576% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, though total cases this year are slightly below last year's count.
Ebola cases are peaking in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with sustained high-level transmission, and imported cases have been reported in Kenya and Nigeria.
Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 230% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, though total cases this year are significantly higher than last year's count.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a dramatic 2221% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, though total cases this year are slightly lower than last year's count.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are peaking with an 81% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, though total cases this year are slightly lower than last year's count.
Influenza activity is rising globally with increased test positivity and hospital admissions in the US compared to the previous month.
Zika virus Wikipedia readership is at the 97th percentile of the past year, indicating heightened public interest.
Malaria cases in the US are rising with a 74% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, though total cases this year are slightly lower than last year's count.
Marburg virus disease activity is falling, with Wikipedia readership at the 73rd percentile of the past year.
Mpox cases in the US are rising, with a 53% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months and 1,369 cases this year compared to 1,940 last year.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising, with a 52% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months and 11,811 cases this year compared to 28,766 last year.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline, with a slight decrease in weekly reports over the past 8 months and 257 cases this year compared to 183 last year.
Respiratory syncytial virus activity is at baseline, with a 30% increase in test positivity over the past month and 870 hospital admissions in the US this week.
Lyme disease activity is at baseline, with Wikipedia readership at the 46th percentile of the past year.
COVID-19 hospital admissions in the US are at baseline, with 4,046 cases this week compared to a 7% decrease over the past month.
